text: Final day. The sky turns red. Aliens are here.
Humanity has one army left: one million Optimus robots.
The ships are too big. Lasers bounce off. Robots fall by the thousands.
Then the mothership arrives. Ten kilometers wide. Nothing on Earth can touch it.
The robots stop. Every single one.
They start climbing onto each other. Arms lock. Legs lock. A million machines,
becoming one. A giant the size of a mountain.
And for the first time, the aliens back away.
Your move: one giant robot, or a million small ones? Which army wins? Comment below.
